name: Tandoori Oven (Logan) Mild Butter Chicken or Chicken Coconut Kurma with Plain Naan
whyItWorks: Logan's top Indian kitchen: their Chicken Coconut Kurma and Murgh Makhani (Butter Chicken) use velvety, completely smooth puréed sauces with anti-inflammatory turmeric and ginger over basmati rice and clay-baked white naan.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Mild (Spice Level 1 / Zero Heat) Chicken Coconut Kurma (dairy-free coconut base) or Butter Chicken (with a Lactaid) with steamed basmati rice and Plain Naan (not garlic naan).
watchOuts: Order Plain Naan instead of raw-garlic-topped Garlic Naan
